input_data.message: We are building a customer relationship management (CRM) platform for small to medium-sized businesses. The system will help businesses manage their customer contacts, track sales opportunities, manage marketing campaigns, and generate sales reports. Key features include:  - User authentication and role-based access control (admin, sales manager, sales rep) - Contact management: add, edit, delete, and search customer contacts - Sales pipeline management: track deals through stages (lead, qualified, proposal, negotiation, closed-won, closed-lost) - Task and activity tracking: schedule meetings, set reminders, log calls and emails - Email integration: sync with Gmail and Outlook for email tracking - Reporting dashboard: visual analytics for sales performance, conversion rates, and revenue trends - Mobile responsive design: access from desktop and mobile devices  The platform needs to support up to 1000 concurrent users and should integrate with popular third-party services like Stripe for payments and Mailchimp for email marketing. We expect the MVP to launch in 6 months with core features, followed by iterative enhancements based on user feedback.
